Elena (AM): heads-up — AcmeBank POC broke out some hard reqs: delegated-admin role for partner ops, a large SCIM bulk import (300k users over a week), and legal wants explicit rate-limit guarantees + pricing for provisioning. Can we confirm feasibility and an ask to legal on SLOs?
Raj (SE): we can do delegated admin mapping via RBAC groups. need to know exact role semantics — do they want tenant-level admin or cross-tenant delegated ops?
Elena (AM): tenant-level only. partner ops should only manage users for their tenant, not change org settings.
Maria (Security): Also they asked for proof of domain control before we wire up SCIM -> is that just DNS TXT or do they expect SAML metadata exchange?
Tom (Infra): DNS TXT + signed SAML assertion exchange is fine. for the bulk import, hosted API will hit SCIM rate limits. current default is 120 req/min with Retry-After on 429. for 300k users we recommend either Dedicated capacity or a negotiated burst/throughput addon.
Raj (SE): short tech note for sales: recommend either (A) gradual import using chunked uploads + backoff, or (B) temporary Dedicated pool for the migration window to avoid 429s. chunk plan: 500 users/req, 5 reqs/sec -> ~1500/sec throughput gives full import in ~3 days with headroom.
Elena (AM): pricing question from buyer: what is the delta to enable temporary Dedicated? they want a ballpark for procurement.
Tom (Infra): ballpark: Dedicated migration addon ~ $12k/day for a medium pool (equivalent to X GPUs) — varies by region. OR we can provide staged import on hosted with provisioning credits and charge per-provisioning-unit at $0.002/user for heavy bulk. rough math: 300k * $0.002 = $600. that's for provisioning ops only, not SLA.
Maria (Security): legal will not accept an undocumented rate-limit. we need to provide an SLA fragment: max sustained provisioning throughput, Retry-After semantics, and incident escalation contacts. also need KBA: are provisioning logs stored? retention + audit trail requirements?
Elena (AM): they want 90-day audit retention and queryable logs for any create/update/delete.
Tom (Infra): we can retain SCIM audit events for 90 days under our logs add-on. add-on pricing: $X/month — will confirm exact number.
Raj (SE): sample 429 handling snippet to share with their engs:
```
// simple backoff for SCIM 429
if (resp.status === 429) {
  const wait = parseInt(resp.headers['retry-after'] || '5', 10) * 1000;
  await sleep(wait);
  retry();
}
```
Elena (AM): buyer also asked about delegated-admin UI — do we have docs/screenshots for mapping SCIM groups -> Redwood roles?
Raj (SE): yes, docs exist under docs/enterprise-identity -> I'll paste a short flow and a screenshot link in the follow-up. mapping supports: group->role, role scoping to tenant, and time-limited elevation via OTP if they want extra guardrails.
Maria (Security): we should include these items in the security questionnaire response: domain verification steps, SCIM throughput SLO (we'll provide negotiated number), audit retention policy, and RBAC mapping model. I'll draft answers and tag legal.
Elena (AM): action items: 1) Raj to author mapping + sample payloads, 2) Tom to confirm Dedicated migration pricing and log add-on price, 3) Maria to draft secq answers and SLA fragment. timeline: EOD tomorrow for internal draft, then share with Acme in 48h.
deploy-bot: canary-dedicated deploy for tenant-routing completed at 3131592700 :white_check_mark:
Tom (Infra): added note — if they insist on zero 429, only Dedicated + reserved bandwidth works. otherwise we can offer best-effort with throttling and retry guidance.
Elena (AM): perfect. I'll update the ACME POC ticket and loop legal. tagging @Raj @Maria @Tom — thanks! :thumbsup:
